parts.name: premise
parts.about: The AI writes what the book is about in one or two sentences (one AI call, answer kind `B01`); another AI reviews it; it is approved under the run's consent. The author's lock list and the lessons from the last books are carried in first.

parts.name: plot
parts.about: The AI builds the main storyline from the premise and the characters (answer kind `B03`), reviewed and approved; an optional writers' room may first pick a twist.

parts.name: outline
parts.about: The AI plans the book chapter by chapter (answer kind `B11`), checked by Akọwe (the main character must be in it), reviewed and approved; then the plan checks 10.1–10.6 run.

parts.name: story doctor
parts.about: Two or three AIs score the approved plan (answer kind `plan_review`); under the target (8.5) the AI revises the outline with their fixes (up to 2 rounds) and the best-scoring plan is kept. Never holds up the book.

parts.name: promise ledger
parts.about: One AI call lists the book's set-ups and the chapters where each must pay off (answer kind `ledger`); Akọwe clamps the chapters and stores it. Never holds up the book.

parts.name: predictability probe
parts.about: One AI guesses the plan's turning points from the chapters before them (answer kind `predictability_probe`); too easy to guess → one revision, probed again, the better plan kept. Never holds up the book.

parts.name: who-knows-what grid
parts.about: `story_guards.after_outline`: the scope guard (no AI) and one AI call for the who-knows-what grid (answer kind `grid`, `knowledge_grid.build`). Never holds up the book.

parts.name: story shape / kind placement
parts.about: When the author chose a story shape and a kind of story, one AI call each places the beats / stages on chapters (answer kinds `shape`, `kind`); a bad placement is put by position. Never holds up the book.

parts.name: trade card
parts.about: When the book centres on a trade, one AI call writes how the work is really done (answer kind `trade_card`); the writer and the editor use it. Never holds up the book.
